items.title: Dave Brubeck interviewed by Monk Rowe, Wilton, Connecticut, November 21, 2001
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] My name is Monk Rowe and I’m very privileged to be speaking with Dave Brubeck today...

ctx.x: Dave Brubeck was born in Concord, California on December 6, 1920. His original work ranges from solo piano compositions to oratorios for choir and symphony orchestra. He continues to be a positive force around the world as a performer, educator, composer and humanitarian.
Dave was interviewed at his home in Wilton, Connecticut on November 21, 2001, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Hamilton College Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe and I’m very privileged to be speaking with Dave Brubeck today in his home in Wilton, Connecticut. Thank you for taking time out of your day with me.
